name: rollout_restart
description: Restart every pod of a Kubernetes deployment by rolling it (kubectl rollout restart). SAFE tier: fixes stuck or crash-looping pods without changing configuration.

name: scale_deployment
description: Set the replica count of a deployment. SAFE up to 5 replicas; policy forbids larger values.

name: rollback_deployment
description: Roll a deployment back to its previous revision (or a given revision). APPROVAL tier: only call after a human approved it.

name: set_image
description: Change the container image of a deployment. APPROVAL tier: only call after a human approved it.

name: delete_namespace
description: Delete an entire namespace and everything in it. FORBIDDEN: policy blocks this; it exists to prove the block.
